data.name: COLLAPSE MACHINE
data.detailed_description:
• Open world - explore super-magnetic wasteland. Hunt unique flora, gather local fauna, and explore every biome. Breach points of interest.

  • Multiplayer - Play multiplayer with friends via Steam or LAN.

  • Hoard - high-tech tesla-punk gear and other necessities: food, medicine, guns, metals, meat, power cells, devices, and tools

  • Physical inventory - objects must actually fit inside each box.

  • Vehicles - Drive a bunker cargo truck with an interactive interior, a compact one-seat buggy, a pocket-sized hoverboard, or a massive zeppelin with full crew and supplies. Travel your way.

  • Characters - Meet creatures you can trade with, befriend, or rob. Pick up small animals as items - easy pets or emergency snacks.

  • Respawn - Swap bodies after death or irreparable damage. Your shell is replaceable. Meat or metal is your call.

  • Voxel terrain - Dig tunnels or raise voxel walls. Extract metals from dirt, or lay siege to hives.

  • All Memorized - The world remembers everything: cracked rock, moved plants, dead characters, half-used pills.

data.short_description: In COLLAPSE MACHINE - scavenge, raid, and survive a super-magnetic wasteland in co-op PvE. Hoard tesla-punk tech, mine voxel terrain, run a mobile vehicle base through shifting seasons, intercept rivals, and siege their factories
